title: sample-import/1: a table of file -> sample name, role and group laid over the samples of a set of files
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample import --json` and of the `import` op of the `samples` route (same bytes in the site and the app): `samples` is a samples/1 and `report` says what was matched, what was not and every automatic choice. Nothing is refused for a finding; `status` is `partial` when a row or a file is unmatched, duplicate rows disagree or a role word is unknown. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/samples/import.rs.

rows.description: Rows of the table (blank rows skipped).

unmatched_rows.description: Rows that name no file (`no file`) or two or more (`ambiguous`, with the `candidates`): nothing is guessed.

row.description: Row number in the table, the header is row 1.

unmatched_files.description: Files no row names; they keep what their names proposed.

duplicates.description: Files named by two or more rows: the first row is kept (`kept`); `conflict` says whether the rows disagree.

unknown_roles.description: A role word that is not a role; the role the name proposed is kept.

shared_names.description: A sample name on several files: evidence only (one sample in two polarities is two files).

choices.description: Every automatic choice, in the order made: `match:case`, `match:stem`, `match:stem-case` (a row matched without an exact name), `duplicate_first`, `sample_name`, `role` and `group` (the value before and after), `ignored_column`.
